title: Event-Based Early Warning of Vineyard Disease Risk from Environmental Time Series
abstract: arXiv:2605.04548v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate early warning of vineyard disease risk from environmental observations is essential for timely intervention and more sustainable crop protection. However, many existing studies formulate disease prediction as daily presence classification, which can favor persistence-driven predictions and provide only limited support for actionable short-horizon warning. In this paper, we present an event-based approach for early warning of vineyard disease risk from environmental time series and evaluate it through a vineyard case study. Rather than predicting daily disease status, the task is reformulated to predict transitions into annotated disease-risk periods within a future window of 3-7 days. To reduce fragmentation caused by short interruptions in the binary labels, new events are defined only after a minimum disease-free gap. translated_title: 基于事件的环境时间序列葡萄园病害风险早期预警
translated_abstract: 基于环境观测的葡萄园病害风险准确早期预警对于及时干预和更可持续的作物保护至关重要。然而，许多现有研究将病害预测表述为每日存在性分类，这可能导致模型偏向基于持续性的预测，并且只能为可操作的短期预警提供有限支持。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于事件的方法，用于从环境时间序列中对葡萄园病害风险进行早期预警，并通过葡萄园案例研究对其进行评估。该方法不是预测每日病害状态，而是将任务重新表述为预测在未来3-7天窗口内进入已标注病害风险期的转变。为了减少二值标签中短暂中断造成的碎片化，只有在至少一段最短无病害间隔之后才定义新事件。这种表述方式鼓励模型捕捉与即将到来的风险期相关的环境前兆。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于事件的葡萄园病害风险早期预警方法，将任务从每日病害状态分类重新表述为预测未来3-7天内进入病害风险期的转变，并通过最短无病害间隔减少标签碎片化，从而更好地捕捉环境前兆并支持可操作的短期预警。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an event-based approach for early warning of vineyard disease risk by reformulating the task from daily disease status classification to predicting transitions into disease-risk periods within a 3-7 day future window, using a minimum disease-free gap to reduce label fragmentation and enable models to capture environmental precursors for actionable short-horizon warnings.
